question: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must activate the port-security database on a Cisco MDS 9000 Series Switch for VSAN 100, but receives the error shown. Which command completes the configuration?
context: "Error for VSAN 100: Activation not permitted with auto-learn ON"
theory: The error occurs because auto-learning is automatically enabled by default whenever port security is activated, and normally that must be explicitly disabled before the database can be (re)activated. Appending the force keyword to port-security activate vsan 100 overrides this restriction, letting the administrator activate the database despite auto-learning still being on, effectively accepting the currently learned/static entries as the enforced baseline. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 20 - Port Security, Activation and Auto-Learning)
